title: AI News Daily — August 21, 2026
summary: The White House briefed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google on a frontier-model testing framework it called ‘finalized’ back on August 4 — but still hasn’t shown companies the actual document. Anthropic, meanwhile, bundled computer use, browser access, skills, and files into one production-ready Claude agent surface. And Meta turns out to be quietly one of Microsoft’s largest AI customers, paying Azure hundreds of millions a year to run rival models.
